$comment: Trusted receiver policy, read from the PR base ref only (git show <base_sha>:<path>), never from the PR's own tree. Each entry names a behavioral check this receiver independently RE-RUNS against the candidate's real bytes (see execute_receiver_checks in receiver/check.py) -- never the untrusted evidence package's own self-reported checks/run_check.py result. candidateScratchRelative/testScratchRelative describe an explicit throwaway scratch-directory layout (not guessed from the real repo's own paths) that mirrors the sibling-file layout the trusted test itself expects.
